question: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q3 FY2027 earnings release? (Operating expenses (GAAP))

calls.reasoning: Recent GAAP opex guidance steps: Q1 7.7 -> Q2 8.5 -> Q3 9.2 (+0.8, +0.7); last year Q3->Q4 guide step was +0.8 (5.9->6.7). Mgmt on Q2 call: FY27 opex to grow 'low 50s' %; FY26 GAAP opex 23.076B, Q1+Q2 actual 16.03B, Q3 ~9.15B -> implied Q4 ~9.4 (50%) to ~10.1 (53%), ~9.9 at 52%. Non-GAAP basis reading pushes implied Q4 toward ~9.6 GAAP. Last year full-year opex growth guidance ('high 30s') was exceeded (~41%), suggesting upside lean. No prediction market found (harness found none on Polymarket/Manifold; Kalshi/bookmakers not checked). Median ~9.9.

Judgment disputes: the exact meaning of 'low 50s' (50-53%) and whether Q4 repeats the larger historical Q4 step (~+12%, ~10.3) or the recent +0.7-0.8 step (~9.9-10.0). The step trend and 52-53% growth line up at ~10.0, which I take as the median, slightly above Run 2 and below Run 3 on the evidence. Kept a small low-side escape below 9.45 (~50% growth reading).
